why_ai: An owner cooks, drives and serves by hand at changing locations; customers still want the food.
why_clarity: Daily sales show the outcome at once, but location choice and food quality run on feel.
why_digital: Raw ingredients cooked in a truck and handed to walk-up customers who find it via social media.

why_ai: Health codes require a licensed physical kitchen and storage space that software cannot supply.
why_clarity: Facility operations and tenant compliance follow health-code checklists with regular inspections.
why_digital: Physical kitchen space rented in person to local mobile operators.

why_ai: Kitchen space plus hands-on mentoring of food entrepreneurs, delivered in person by programme staff.
why_clarity: Each entrepreneur differs and business outcomes take years to show for funders.
why_digital: Kitchen space and in-person training for local entrepreneurs, with outcome reports to funders.

why_ai: Demand matching and pricing guidance are marketplace software functions AI can run.
why_clarity: Bookings and per-event revenue give measurable, recurring outcomes soon after each event.
why_digital: Booking requests in, placements out through an online marketplace.

why_ai: Cooking and serving on festival grounds is hands-on, and event selection is a high-stakes bet.
why_clarity: Event outcomes swing with weather and attendance, and each festival is a distinct bet.
why_digital: Food cooked and served in person at events, booked through applications and organisers.

why_ai: Vendor spend analytics are automatable, but line-up curation rests on vendor relationships.

why_digital: Sales data and applications in, vendor selections out, tied to physical event sites.

why_ai: Unit models and territory analysis automate, but franchisee build-out support stays hands-on.
why_clarity: Territory and unit-economics bets are few and their outcomes take years.
why_digital: Network performance data in, models out, with franchisee support partly in person.

why_ai: Specs must satisfy local fire and health code inspections and turn into a physically built kitchen.
why_clarity: Each build is custom to a menu, but code compliance passes or fails at inspection.
why_digital: Menu needs in, design specs and a physically built mobile kitchen out.

why_ai: Visit modelling from device panels is data science; the moat is panel access, not people.

why_digital: Device location data in, subscription analytics out, entirely digital.

why_digital: Order and trade-area data in, site models out, for internal real estate teams.

why_clarity: Nightly rush revenue shows quickly, but crowd behaviour is highly variable.
why_digital: Cash-heavy, walk-up, in-person food service with no online channel.

why_ai: Location choice is a daily prediction from weather, events and traffic that a model can make.
why_clarity: Revenue per spot is known the same day, though operators decide by unwritten feel.
why_digital: Weather, event and sales data in, a daily parking recommendation out.

why_digital: Surveys and ordinance comparisons are documents, but advocacy is local and in person.

why_clarity: Loss ratios are measurable, but claims experience accrues over years on a small class.

why_digital: On-site physical inspections of trucks by local public employees.

why_digital: Receipts, texts and records in, books, posts and schedules out, all on screen.
